name: sisso-sage
description: AI-ready inspection, evidence retrieval, and model selection for completed SISSO regression runs.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-driven SISSO model analysis for AI.
interface.longDescription: Inspect completed SISSO runs, compare model evidence, trace feature provenance and source context, generate objective-evidence shortlists, and guide categorical semantic review without scalar interpretability scores.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my SISSO run and report whether it is safe to analyze.
Select objective-evidence finalists and compare their structural, domain, provenance, and semantic-review evidence.
Trace the source and meaning of features used by my finalist models.
